# How much Stamp Duty will I pay on this house?

> Free UK Stamp Duty (SDLT) calculator for England and Northern Ireland from April 2025: standard rates, first-time buyer relief, the 5% second home and buy-to-let rate and the 2% non-UK resident surcharge, with a band-by-band breakdown. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
